name: San Marino

flag.description: Two equal horizontal bands, white over light blue, with the national coat of arms in the center: three towers on three peaks in a shield, framed by a wreath, topped by a crown and above a scroll reading 'LIBERTAS'.
flag.symbolism: White is commonly said to represent peace and the snow of Monte Titano, and light blue the sky and liberty; the three towers stand on the mountain's three peaks.

hook: San Marino is snow over sky, white above light blue, with the three towers of Monte Titano crowned in the middle.
trivia: San Marino claims to be the world's oldest surviving republic, traditionally founded in 301 AD.
The motto on the flag, 'Libertas', is Latin for 'Liberty'.
